description:
Generate a new 2048-bit Certificate Signing Request (CSR) for the virtual server 'acmecorp.test'. Use the following organization details:
- Country: US
- State: Washington
- City: Seattle
- Organization: Acme Corporation
- Organizational Unit: Web Operations
- Email: admin@acmecorp.test
- Key Size: 2048 bits

Navigate to the SSL management section for the domain, generate the CSR, and save the resulting CSR text (including the BEGIN/END header/footer) to a file named '/home/ga/Documents/acmecorp.csr'.
